title: FindingSchema
description: Minimal schema definition for security findings identified by deterministic rules.

finding_id.description: Unique identifier for the finding type or rule

title.description: Short descriptive title of the finding

explanation.description: Detailed explanation of the security issue

session_id.description: Optional identifier of the session associated with this finding

evidence.description: Optional frame or packet evidence supporting this finding

frame_number.description: Frame number where the issue was observed

observed_value.description: Concrete observed cryptographic or protocol value

examples.title: Deprecated TLS version
examples.explanation: The session used an outdated TLS version.
